title: My first Steam game: a small boat rental tycoon set on Lake Lugano, built with AI assistance
author: hackmuraz
selftext:
I’m not a professional game developer. I started with a personal challenge: could I actually build and finish a game of my own? That became Lugano Bay Tycoon, a small management game inspired by Lake Lugano in Switzerland.

You run a boat rental business: buy pedal boats and other boats, set prices, manage maintenance, and grow your operation while dealing with customers, weather, and seasons. I wanted to make something small and relaxing, with a setting that means something to me.

The Steam page has just reached 109 wishlists, including 16 since yesterday. Seeing people interested in this little project is encouraging. If small management games are your thing, take a look - wishlists are very welcome! 

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5235040/LUGANO\_BAY\_TYCOON/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5235040/LUGANO_BAY_TYCOON/)

comments.author: chasebeast
comments.body: how did you do this? any youtube videos you watched?

replies.author: hackmuraz
replies.body:
Hey, thanks for your interest! I took inspiration from a few YouTube tutorials, but didn’t follow any particular one from start to finish. A friend and mentor taught me a lot about working with AI for game development. Sadly, he passed away two months ago.

I kept going with help from Claude and ChatGPT, with a lot of trial and error and plenty of things I had to fix along the way. Finishing the game became something personal to me. I wanted to see it through in his memory.
